verdict_reason: The rebase resolution reverts main's EUDPA-696 Welsh check-answers copy wholesale rather than only removing the contact-address keys.

todos.issue: The rebase conflict resolution (7b5a259, 714a8f5) reverted main's EUDPA-696 (#484, 32236d4) Welsh check-answers copy instead of only dropping contact address: against base 32236d4 the PR restores the pre-#484 shape from c4aec87 (cards/groups swapped back to importDetails/reasonForImport/rolesAndAddresses, sections documents '4. Dogfennau' and consignmentParties '5. Partïon y llwyth', identifierTable in place of identificationDetails 'Manylion adnabod', hidden.numberOfAnimals/identificationDetails/document/rows removed, errors.species.noCount/noIdentifier removed, groups.permanentAddress removed, importReferences warning reworded). copy.en.js and the rest of the CYA stack (39 files, +1383/-3159) are reverted the same way. EUDPA-776 asks only to remove the contact address page; merging this undoes Design Release 2.1's overview and review page.
todos.fix: Must: against main, this file's only change is the removal of the contact-address keys (sections.contactAddress, cards.contactAddress, rows.contactAddress, hidden.cards.contactAddress, errors.cards.contactAddress, the invalid-party contactAddress message); every key and string #484 added is kept. One way: git checkout origin/main -- the check-answers folder, then re-apply only the contact-address removals (and the matching ones in copy.en.js, the view-model, template and tests).
